Classic scripts without async or defer can block parsing. Defer preserves order and runs after
parsing; async runs when ready. Module scripts defer by default.

Jවනවා. async එක download වුණු ගමන් run Jවන්න පුළුවන්.

<script defer src="app.js"></script>
<script async src="analytics.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="main.js"></script>
Expected result: External scripts load according to their attributes.
Interview question: When should you use defer rather than async?
Answer: When execution order or a parsed DOM is required for classic scripts.
Practice: Compare script execution order using console logs.
